searched: Searched on 29 October 2026, direct retrieval only. arXiv API title searches for Hunyuan, HunyuanVideo, Hunyuan3D, HunyuanImage, HunyuanWorld, HunyuanOCR and related titles (about 27 reports found; five cited at version 1: Hunyuan-DiT 2405.08748, Hunyuan-Large 2411.02265, Hunyuan-TurboS 2505.15431, HunyuanImage 3.0 2509.23951, Hunyuan-A13B 2609.27284. Retrieved but not drafted: HunyuanVideo 2412.03603 and Hunyuan3D 2.0 2501.12202, whose title pages name only the 'Hunyuan Foundation Model Team' and 'Hunyuan3D Team' with no corporate affiliation (HunyuanVideo is recorded from its tencent Hugging Face model card instead), and Hunyuan-MT 2509.05209, left out for budget). Hugging Face API for the tencent organisation (100 most recent repositories with licence tags) and model info, commit lists, LICENSE and README files at head revisions for Tencent-Hunyuan-Large, HunyuanVideo, Hunyuan-A13B-Instruct, Hy3-preview, Hy3 and Hy4-preview; the Hugging Face commit list endpoint returned only one page of commits, so head revisions were taken from the model-info API and earlier licence revisions were not compared. tencent.com: financial-reports page, Annual Reports 2025 and 2023 (English PDFs from static.www.tencent.com, not the HKEXnews copies), the reports page and ESG Report 2025, the governance page, and site searches for 'Hunyuan' and 'AI safety', which located the Hunyuan launch post (7 September 2023) and the Hy3 preview, Hy3 and Hy4 preview posts. Refusal: the WordPress API at https://www.tencent.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=Hunyuan returned HTTP 401 (the site search page was used instead). Not retrieved: HKEXnews filings (not searched; the tencent.com copies were used), GitHub Tencent-Hunyuan repositories (not needed for the licence texts, which were read on Hugging Face), the Chinese-language versions of the newsroom posts and annual reports, and the Internet Archive (refused from this environment). Left out for budget, though sourced in the cache: Dowson Tong's role as Senior Executive Vice President and CEO of CSIG in the 2023 launch post; the Hong Kong governing-law clause of the licences; principle 4 of the Responsible AI Principles (communicating capability limits). Left out: individual shareholdings in Tencent Computer stated in the annual report (living persons' shareholdings); performance and benchmark statements; licences of the many other tencent repositories (Hy-MT2, Hy-Memory and others show Apache-2.0 tags; HunyuanImage-3.0 and HY-World-2.0 show 'other'), which were seen only as API tags; Hy4 preview's Apache-2.0 LICENSE (retrieved, noted in the Hy4 preview record's qualification only); authorship records (no person in existing-entities appears in the author lists; Yao Shunyu appears in the A13B report only as a cited author); founding (no Tencent founding statement retrieved; the annual reports give Tencent Technology's establishment date but not the holding company's incorporation date). No Tencent AI safety framework in the sense of a standalone published document was located; the Responsible AI Principles in the ESG Report 2025 are recorded instead. Doubtful identity: the existing entity `tencent` carries the alias 深圳市腾讯计算机系统有限公司, which the annual report (in English) describes as a separate operating company controlled by contract; this draft proposes a separate entity for it, and the alias needs a decision.

time.note: LICENSE at the head revision 6204ad6a (6 March 2025). The LICENSE as uploaded on 2 December 2024 (5687e9af) excluded the European Union only; the update of 4 December 2024 (a4ed25a9) added the United Kingdom and South Korea; the text at 6204ad6a is identical to that of 4 December.

claims.qualification: Described as the text describes itself; no judgement of open source. Like the Large edition, it defines 'Tencent' as THL A29 Limited.

evidence.passage: TENCENT HUNYUAN COMMUNITY LICENSE AGREEMENT Tencent HunyuanVideo Release Date: December 3, 2024

claims.subject: hunyuan-community-licence-video-2024

object.value: Agreement does not apply in the European Union, United Kingdom and South Korea; Territory excludes them

claims.statement: The HunyuanVideo edition of the Tencent Hunyuan Community License Agreement states that it does not apply in the European Union, United Kingdom and South Korea, and defines the Territory as the worldwide territory excluding them.

time.note: The LICENSE as uploaded on 2 December 2024 (5687e9af) excluded the European Union only; the update of 4 December 2024 (a4ed25a9) added the United Kingdom and South Korea. The text cited, at 6204ad6a (6 March 2025), is identical to that of 4 December. The agreement itself states a release date of 3 December 2024.

claims.qualification: What the text states; no reason is given or recorded. The same exclusion appears in the A13B edition (2025) and the Tencent Hy Community License Agreement for Hy3 preview (2026); the Large edition excludes the European Union only. Between 2 and 4 December 2024 the uploaded text excluded the European Union only.

evidence.passage: THIS LICENSE AGREEMENT DOES NOT APPLY IN THE EUROPEAN UNION, UNITED KINGDOM AND SOUTH KOREA AND IS EXPRESSLY LIMITED TO THE TERRITORY, AS DEFINED BELOW.
“Territory” shall mean the worldwide territory, excluding the territory of the European Union, United Kingdom and South Korea.

claims.subject: hunyuan-community-licence-video-2024

object.value: No use of the works or their outputs to improve any other AI model

claims.statement: The HunyuanVideo edition of the Tencent Hunyuan Community License Agreement forbids using the Tencent Hunyuan Works or their outputs to improve any other AI model, other than Tencent Hunyuan or its derivatives.

time.note: Release date stated in the agreement; read at revision 6204ad6a.

claims.qualification: What the text states; the Large edition's wording is 'any other large language model'. Enforcement is not recorded.

evidence.passage: to improve any other AI model (other than Tencent Hunyuan or Model Derivatives thereof).

Coordinator recheck of the repository history: LICENSE was added at the initial commit of 25 June 2025, replaced the same day (e4205af) and re-uploaded on 27 June 2025 (5aa842d) with changes in whitespace and line endings only; it is unchanged since.

claims.qualification: Described as the text describes itself; no judgement of open source. Its territorial exclusion matches the HunyuanVideo edition.

evidence.passage: TENCENT HUNYUAN COMMUNITY LICENSE AGREEMENT Tencent Hunyuan A13B Release Date: June 27, 2025

claims.subject: hunyuan-community-licence-a13b-2025

object.value: 'Tencent' defined as the applicable entity or entities in the Tencent corporate family owning the rights in the Materials

claims.statement: The Hunyuan A13B edition of the Tencent Hunyuan Community License Agreement defines 'Tencent', 'We' or 'Us' as the applicable entity or entities in the Tencent corporate family that own the rights embodied in or used by the Materials, where the Large and HunyuanVideo editions name THL A29 Limited.

time.note: Release date stated in the agreement; read at revision 290ddb9a.

claims.qualification: Compares the definitions as the cited revisions state them; the agreement does not name the entity or entities, and none is inferred. The Tencent Hy Community License Agreement for Hy3 preview (2026) uses the same definition.

evidence.passage: “Tencent,” “We” or “Us” shall mean the applicable entity or entities in the Tencent corporate family that own(s) intellectual property or other rights embodied in or utilized by the Materials.
“Tencent,” “We” or “Us” shall mean THL A29 Limited.

claims.subject: tencent
claims.statement: The LICENSE file of the tencent/Hy3 Hugging Face repository states that Tencent Hy3 is licensed under the Apache-2.0 and reproduces the Apache License, Version 2.0, and the model card states that Hy3 is released under the Apache License 2.0.

time.note: LICENSE and README at the head revision a960ebc3 (20 July 2026); the repository was created on 2 July 2026 and earlier revisions were not compared.

claims.qualification: The licence of the Hy3 weights as the repository states it at the cited revision; the Hy3 preview weights (April 2026) carry the Tencent Hy Community License Agreement instead. The record does not establish the licensing of training data or of other Tencent models.

evidence.passage: Tencent Hy3 is licensed under the Apache-2.0.
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
Hy3 is released under the … Apache License 2.0

claims.subject: tencent
claims.statement: Tencent's ESG Report 2025 includes a section 'Responsible Artificial Intelligence' that sets out five 'Tencent Responsible AI Principles', the opening principle stating that AI should always serve humanity in line with the corporate mission of Tech for Good.

time.note: No publication date found in the report text; the PDF is served from a tencent.com path dated 2026/04/09 and the report covers 2025. Earlier ESG reports were not compared, so the date from which the principles were stated is not established.

claims.qualification: What the report states; it does not establish implementation. The principles are recorded as a section of the ESG report, not as a standalone document.

evidence.passage: Tencent Responsible AI Principles

evidence.locator: Section 3.3, Tencent Responsible AI Principles, principle 1
evidence.passage: We believe that AI should always serve humanity, in line with our corporate mission of Tech for Good.

claims.subject: tencent-esg-report-2025

object.value: Risk identification and response mechanism across R&D, deployment and operation, with safety red lines

claims.statement: Principle 3 of the Tencent Responsible AI Principles in the ESG Report 2025 states that Tencent has established a risk identification and response mechanism covering R&D, deployment and operational phases, and sets safety red lines.

time.note: Report undated in its text; see the record of the report.

claims.qualification: What the report states; the red lines themselves are not specified in the passage, and implementation is not recorded.

evidence.passage: We have established a risk identification and response mechanism covering R&D, deployment, and operational phases. By setting safety red lines and iteratively optimising protective measures

claims.subject: tencent-esg-report-2025

object.value: AI Technical Committee under the group-level Technical Committee provides security assessments and governance on AI projects

claims.statement: The ESG Report 2025 states that Tencent's AI Technical Committee, a sub-committee of the group-level Technical Committee made up of AI technical leads from its business groups, is responsible for cross-departmental technical coordination and for security assessments and governance on AI projects.

time.note: Report undated in its text; the report does not date the committee's establishment.

claims.qualification: What the report states about the committee's remit and composition; its members, decisions and actual operation are not recorded.

evidence.passage: The AI Technical Committee, one of the sub-committees established under the group-level Technical Committee, is responsible for cross-departmental technical coordination, as well as providing security assessments and governance on AI projects.
Comprising AI technical leads from various business groups
